after.title: Waagerechter Wurf analysieren

Terminal speed 
in free fall:
condition?
before.back:
At terminal speed $v_\text{T}$:

gravity = air resistance

after.front: Terminal speed when falling with air resistance: condition?
after.back:
With negligible buoyancy, at terminal speed $v_\text{T}$:

weight = air-resistance force

$F_G=F_\text{air}$

thus $a=0$ and $v=\text{constant}$, not rest.
